name: OWASP European Summit
summary: About 80 OWASP leaders. Two days of tracks and project workshops, then two days of open working sessions to set the 2009 agenda. Where the working-session format starts.

name: OWASP Global Summit
summary: About 175 people from 20+ countries, four days, "designed in a working session style format": parallel working tracks, no vendor booths, no lecture-only talks.

name: OWASP Summit 2017
where: Woburn Forest Center Parcs, near London · in person
summary: Five days, 16 tracks, over 170 working sessions and 200+ participants, in person and remote, in shared villas. Its best-known outcome is the Mobile Security Testing Guide.

name: Open Security Summit 2018
where: Woburn Forest Center Parcs, England · in person
summary: The first Open Security Summit: the 2017 format, broadened from OWASP to security in general. Keynotes from Adam Shostack, Simon Wardley, Jane Frankland and others, and a one-day summit on 3 July.
facts: About 300 sessions on the site, 129 of them working sessions

name: Open Security Summit 2019
where: Woburn Forest Center Parcs, England · in person
summary: The second week at Woburn, with keynotes on SAMM v2, the MSTG, Juice Shop, ZAP, Cynefin and Wardley maps. The year Open Security Summit CIC was incorporated, on 9 April 2019.
facts: Biggest tracks: OWASP SAMM (28), OWASP MSTG (22)

name: Open Security Summit 2020
summary: The pandemic moved the summit online: two training weeks from 1 June, then the summit week of 15–19 June, with new tracks on Covid apps, Cynefin and Team Topologies.

name: The mini-summits
summary: Online summit weeks every one to two months, 27 of them: threat modelling, DevSecOps, governance, Wardley maps, and from 2023 some of the first sessions on generative AI and agents for security teams.
facts: About 340 session pages from Oct 2020 to Dec 2024
219 recorded videos linked from the site

name: The pause
summary: A March 2025 mini-summit was announced and never ran. The website had grown too complex to change quickly, and there was nobody to follow up. [Why](/articles/when-the-website-stalled-the-summit.html).

name: The restart
summary: A regular run of short working sessions, called when the participants can make them, starting with [php2shell](/sessions/php2shell/); in-person events in London; a programme of hosted open projects starting with Agent Behaviour Policies; and this site. [What is next](/events/).
